Bill gains 2.5% Projectile Speed (up to 50%) and 1%

(with no cap) at specific kill thresholds. Bill will not gain Speed if Speed has reached its cap of +400%. Kill thresholds start at 100 total enemies killed, and increase by 1.3x whenever they are reached, meaning Bill will get stat bonuses at 100, 130, 169, 220, etc. total kills.

Since the kill threshold scales exponentially, it will drastically slow down. In a typical run, the player will not get much more than +30% to +33% Might. By +35%, the kill threshold is just under 1 million.
